note: Register of component duplication findings from the 2026-09-12 audit (docs/release/component-duplication.md). `decision` is one of KEEP / REFACTOR / MERGE / SPLIT / INTERNALIZE / DEPRECATE / REMOVE; `state` is DONE / PLANNED / DEFERRED. `removed` lists public symbols that must no longer exist per platform once the entry is DONE; `requires` lists file/substring evidence the gate verifies. tooling/check-duplicate-components.mjs enforces this file; --strict (release-check) fails while any entry is not DONE. `pending` lists native symbols / site demos whose fate the entry decides; the dead-components gate warns about them until the entry is DONE.

entries.title: Timeline views vs standalone message bodies vs business views
entries.into: one body per content type: Flare*Message is the implementation, MessagesView/views/*View.vue are thin adapters

entries.title: VoiceMessage vs VoicePlayer
entries.into: VoiceMessage stays the in-timeline body; VoicePlayer stays the full transport used by media viewers (flare-core-flutter-app video_player_modal.dart audioOnly path)
entries.rationale: Different jobs, not two skins: the body renders a message with reply/reaction chrome; the player is a scrubbable transport with speed control. Shared waveform tokens are covered by the style audit.

entries.title: TimeStamp vs DatePill
entries.into: DatePill

entries.title: MessageList inline scroll-to-bottom button vs ScrollToLatest
entries.into: MessageList composes ScrollToLatest

entries.title: PrimaryButton vs Button(variant=primary, size=lg, block)
entries.into: Button

entries.title: FlareChatHeader (+Identity) vs ConversationHeader
entries.into: ConversationHeader

entries.title: FlareStartConversationSheet vs StartConversationDialog
entries.into: StartConversationDialog (renders as FlareBottomSheet where the platform capability bottomSheet is true, otherwise a centered modal)

entries.title: composer/MessageActionSheet.vue (attachment grid) vs ComposerActionPanel; MessageContextMenuSheet unregistered
entries.into: ComposerActionPanel owns the grid; MessageActionSheet is the long-press panel on four platforms

entries.title: ConversationListContainer vs FlareConversationListPanel
entries.into: ConversationListContainer (the panel composition moved to the reference workbench as product code)

entries.title: Seven workspace aliases vs WorkspaceFrame
entries.into: WorkspaceFrame

entries.title: MasterDetailLayout / ThreePaneLayout vs AdaptiveWorkbench
entries.into: AdaptiveWorkbench (the pane grids are private helpers of the workbench on the platforms that compose them); the workbench itself was retired into AppLayout in D18

entries.title: AppShell vs MobileAppShell + DesktopAppShell
entries.into: MobileAppShell / DesktopAppShell

entries.title: MessagePreviewModal / MediaComposerPreviewModal / ImagePreviewModal / VideoPlayerModal
entries.into: ImagePreviewModal / VideoPlayerModal stay the media viewers; MessagePreviewModal moved to the reference workbench (product); the composer pre-send preview is registered as ComposerMediaPreview

entries.title: EmojiPicker + StickerPanel vs FlareComposerEmojiStickerPanel
entries.into: the combined picker is registered as EmojiStickerPicker on four platforms (Vue symbol FlareEmojiStickerPicker); EmojiPicker / StickerPanel stay as the data-driven pickers (flare-social android uses EmojiPicker for reactions)

entries.title: ConversationWorkspace (ResponsiveLayout family) vs AppLayout family breakpoints and pane state
entries.into: shared WorkspacePane primitive on four platforms; one breakpoint source in shared/contracts/layout.ts

entries.title: Composer inline send / reply / voice vs ComposerSendButton / ComposerReplyStrip / VoiceHoldButton
entries.into: FlareComposer composes ComposerReplyStrip (reply + edit contexts), ComposerSendButton, MentionPicker and ComposerActionPanel; the upload strip, format strip and voice panel became private parts; VoiceHoldButton / VoiceRecordingBar stay the hold-to-talk parts used by the native composers (the Vue desktop panel needs pause / resume / preview)

entries.title: SceneList rows vs ContactItem / SettingsRow
entries.into: SceneList renders kit parts (FlareButton, the settings group card) and resolves its states through WorkspacePane

entries.title: AdaptiveWorkbench vs AppLayout
entries.into: AppLayout (the one pane composition: it measures its box, follows the shared pane rule and reports its presentation; the workbench did none of these and had no consumer)

entries.title: DesktopWorkbench vs DesktopAppShell (naming-pattern hit)
entries.into: DesktopAppShell (paneMode / detailMode / widths and the seven keyboard commands moved over; resizablePanes, filesDropped and contextMenu retired — Flutter-only, zero consumers)

entries.title: useViewport (600/900) vs useFlareAdaptive (599/1023) breakpoints
entries.into: one threshold pair in shared/contracts/layout.ts; useViewport derives from it

entries.title: QRCard / RedPacketCard / FriendListContainer flagged as low-usage
entries.into: unchanged
entries.rationale: Real consumers outside the kit: flare-social web/tauri/flutter/ios/android apps use QRCard and FriendListContainer; RedPacketCard is a business message body reachable through MessageContentView.
